basic_details.job_title: NPC Project Executive Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The National Productivity Council (NPC), an autonomous body under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, has invited applications for 3 Project Executive (AIP) posts (post code PE/01) on a 2-year contract at its Chennai office. Applications must be emailed to [email protected] on or before 23 November 2026 by 3:00 pm, using the Annex-AF form. Graduates in any discipline can apply.

content_sections.heading: About NPC
content_sections.text: The National Productivity Council is an autonomous body under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, with its office at 5-6 Institutional Area, Lodhi Road, New Delhi - 110003. According to the notice, it promotes productivity consciousness in the country for sustainable socio-economic development through consultancy, research and training activities in different sectors of the economy. NPC Head Quarter (HQ), New Delhi invites these applications purely on a contractual basis for its Chennai office.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email to [email protected] . The notice states the deadline as "on or before 23/11/2026 by 3:00 pm"; it does not say whether this is for receipt or dispatch. Fill in the application in the format of Annex-AF, "Application for engagement as contractual person in NPC", printed in the notice. Fill in the Appendix, "Details of Experience", printed with the form. Attach self-attested copies of all requisite documents and a latest photo. Email the application to [email protected] on or before 23/11/2026 by 3:00 pm. Write the post code in the email subject; the notice gives PE/01 as the example. Incomplete applications, and applications without self-attested copies of documents, will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: NPC has advertised one post, Project Executive (AIP), post code PE/01, with 3 vacancies. The type of engagement is Full Time and the place of deployment is Chennai. Qualification: Graduate in any discipline. Skill: Good command over MS Office. Experience: 0-5 years. Preference: Will be given to Graduates in Engineering with experience. Remuneration: Rs 28,000 – Rs 50,000 per month based on experience. Contract period: 2 years. The notice mentions no other allowance on top of this remuneration, and no age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the full conditions.

content_sections.heading: NPC Project Executive (AIP) Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist consultants in execution of consultancy assignments, including data collection, analysis and report preparation. Coordinate training programmes, including participant registration, faculty coordination and training material preparation. Prepare presentations, project reports, training materials and other required documentation. Liaise with client organisations, participants and stakeholders for information sharing and coordination. Provide administrative and logistical support for consultancy assignments and training programmes. Maintain project records, monitor progress and assist consultants in meeting deliverables and timelines.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the Annex-AF format, with the Appendix "Details of Experience". Self-attested copies of all requisite documents. Latest photo. Self-attested copy of proof of date of birth. Self-attested copy of Aadhaar. Self-attested copies of educational/technical qualification documents, and experience certificates. Copy of PPO, with the date of retirement and the office last worked in, in case of a retired person.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Executive (AIP) posts has NPC advertised?
faq.answer: NPC has advertised 3 (Three) Project Executive (AIP) posts under post code PE/01 for its Chennai office.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NPC Project Executive (AIP)?
faq.answer: The application must be sent by email on or before 23/11/2026 by 3:00 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NPC Project Executive (AIP)?
faq.answer: The qualification is Graduate in any discipline, with good command over MS Office and experience of 0-5 years. Preference will be given to Graduates in Engineering with experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of NPC Project Executive (AIP)?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs 28,000 – Rs 50,000 per month based on experience.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for NPC Project Executive (AIP)?
faq.answer: Send the application as per Annex-AF, with self-attested copies of all requisite documents and a latest photo, by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What should I write in the email subject?
faq.answer: The code number of the post applied for must be mentioned in the subject; the notice gives PE/01 as the example.

faq.question: Q7. Is the NPC Project Executive (AIP) job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on a contract basis for 2 years and does not confer any right to regular appointment in NPC or its associated organisations.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Project Executive (AIP) be posted?
faq.answer: The place of deployment is Chennai, and the type of engagement is Full Time.

faq.question: Q9. Will NPC provide a laptop to the contractual person?
faq.answer: No laptop will be provided by the organisation, according to the General Conditions in the notice.

faq.question: Q10. Which applications will be rejected?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications and applications without self-attested copies of documents will be rejected.
